name: Prerana (micro Credit Finance) Scheme
briefDescription: DR. BR Ambedkar Development Corporation launched the Prerana scheme to finance Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe Women Self Help Groups for mass production/service units.
descriptionMd: The Prerana (micro Credit Finance) Scheme, launched by DR. BR Ambedkar Development Corporation in Karnataka, aims to empower Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Women Self Help Groups. It provides financial assistance to these groups to establish or expand mass production or service units, fostering economic self-reliance and community development.
benefitsMd:
* Financial assistance for Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe Women Self Help Groups.
* Funding for mass production / service units.
* For a group of 10 members, Rs. 2,50,000 /- will be allowed.
* Rs. 15,000 /- subsidy.
* Rs. 10,000 /- Margin Money.
eligibilityMd:
* Must be Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe Women Self Help Groups.
* Groups should be involved in mass production or service units.
* Groups must consist of 10 members to be eligible for Rs. 2,50,000 finance.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
